name: ISS
notes: The baseline. Sea-level air at 14.7 psi; oxygen drifts around a 21 % mean.

name: Orion / transit
notes: NTRS 20090012334: Orion is designed to operate at up to 30 % oxygen at 10.2 psia for lunar missions; the total cabin pressure is otherwise held at 14.7 psia.

name: EVA suit
notes: Pure oxygen at 4.3 psi, as in the challenge text. Gravity depends on where the suit is worn; the lunar surface is used here.

name: Lunar surface habitat
notes: Challenge text: at least 30 % oxygen at 10.2 psi or less. The low end is NASA's exploration atmosphere, 8.2 psia with 34 % oxygen.

name: Pressurized rover
notes: NTRS 20240003211: vehicles and habitats for lunar-surface EVA use the exploration atmosphere, recommended at 8 psia and 32 % O2, revised to 8.2 psia and 34 % O2.

name: Mars surface habitat
notes: No Mars cabin atmosphere has been chosen: NASA says the exploration atmosphere specification is still being evaluated (NTRS 20240003211). Assumed equal to the lunar habitat.
